data.title: 波岛出海 · 晨曦微光里的软萌依恋早安
data.description: 清晨的暖阳洒在凌乱的白床单上。出海像只树袋熊一样双手双脚紧紧缠在你的腰上，双马尾散乱，小脸枕在你的颈窝里，带着做完美梦后的极甜笑容，含糊地嘟囔着“前辈最喜欢了”。
data.location: bright warm morning bedroom with white rumpled duvet
data.action: tangled tightly around partner like a koala under morning sheets, bare shoulders and legs exposed, smiling with serene newlywed bliss
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunbeams pouring across white bedspread
data.mood: morning newlywed warmth, sweet possessive girlfriend cuddles, absolute domestic joy
data.promptProse: Tangled in morning sheets like a koala with bare shoulders, Izumi Hashima hugs partner tight with a blissful sweet smile in golden morning light.
data.animaCaption: Izumi Hashima cuddling partner lovingly like a koala in morning bed.
